title: Go‑live comms and localized enablement kit for Private VPC RBAC + Audit + KMS
creator: Marco Deluca
description: Create a coordinated go‑to‑market package for the Private/VPC launch of RBAC, Audit Logs, and KMS integration focused on: (1) clear, localized release notes and sent comms; (2) an operator enablement kit with runbooks, checklists, and training; (3) legal and compliance attestations for EU/US customers; and (4) cross‑team launch choreography (Support, Sales, Solutions, Eng, Legal). Goal: reduce first‑contact resolution for new private deploy customers and ensure compliance signoffs are available at GA.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Final release notes approved and localized into en, fr, de, ja; 2) Enablement kit published in Confluence and Drive (runbook, rollback steps, KMS key rotation guide, RBAC matrix); 3) Support playbook and triage runbook tested in dry run with on‑call; 4) Legal/compliance template and customer attestation form approved by Legal; 5) Cross‑team launch checklist executed in canary wave and sign‑offs collected.
release_notes_blob: Private: RBAC, Audit Logs, and KMS integrations are now available for Private/VPC deployments. Admins can configure fine‑grained roles, stream immutable audit events to configured sinks, and integrate with customer KMS for envelope encryption. See migration notes, breaking changes, and example policies in the release notes. This GA includes SLA and recommended operator practices for high‑availability clusters.

Create KMS key rotation playbook and sample scripts
Create RBAC role matrix + example policies
Legal/compliance attestation template and data processing addendum
Prepare Solutions Engineering demo environment and sample templates
Schedule customer enablement webinar and internal dry run
Publish Confluence enablement kit and link in Console release banner
Add monitoring widgets to Console and create dashboard share link
Collect sign‑offs from Eng, Security, Legal, Support, Sales

owner_notes: Tradeoffs considered: single combined release note vs per‑feature micro‑notes. Chose combined note to reduce cognitive overhead for private customers, with clear anchors for RBAC, Audit, KMS. Also decided not to auto‑enable KMS on customer clusters — opt‑in only due to key custody legal concerns. Need explicit sample CLI for key import to reduce support calls.
communication_plan: Phase 1: private beta customers — targeted email + scheduled calls; Phase 2: GA announce via Console banner, Help Center article, and release notes; Phase 3: customer webinars + regional office Q&A (EMEA & APAC). Support and Solutions will receive a pre‑flight doc 48h before GA. Sales brief and one‑pager prepared for SDRs.
post_launch_metrics: # of private upgrades completed within SLA window
first‑contact resolution rate for private RBAC/KMS issues
percentage of customers who complete KMS onboarding without Support
notes_for_support: Include canned CLI snippets for: creating RBAC roles, mapping LDAP groups, importing KMS keys, and configuring audit sinks. Add troubleshooting section for common KMS errors (key mismatch, permission denied) and a runbook to escalate to Eng with required logs and timestamps.
customer_communication_snippet: We're excited to announce GA for Private/VPC: RBAC, Audit Logs, and KMS integration. These features let you control access at role level, capture immutable audit trails, and use your own KMS for encryption. See migration guide and schedule a migration review with Solutions Engineering.
